Strict convexity forces the maximum at central hypercube-section vertices, all but at most one coordinate +/-1. For odd n, n+1 even and balanced cube corners give R^2=1/n; for even n, the sole free coordinate is 0, giving R^2=1/(n+1). Exact combinatorial choices yield the reported farthest-point counts; independently enumerated n=2..10 as checks, and the proof holds for all n.
